The reason it smells like that

Everything in this shop spent a night on a rack

Sausage, cheese, poultry, jerky — it all goes into the same smokehouse out back. Open the door and see what's hanging.

Rings of house sausage, hung overnight.

Racks turn over through the week — call ahead if you're driving out for something specific.

Twenty-two years on this street

Started by one smoker, kept going by two

Curt Konoske opened The Smoke House and More in 2004, mentored by Jack Thompson. It is owned and run today by Gina Vaughan and Daniel Ellis.

When you arrive on Railroad Ave you can't help but feel you stepped back in time, to when this town was a booming coal mining industry. The shop sits between the Historic Black Diamond Museum and the Bakery — a gourmet specialty shop tucked into a block that hasn't changed much.

Old-time favorites are the whole point: summer sausage, double smoked bacon, smoked cheeses, and a wide variety of extras. Step in and enjoy the wondrous smells of the smokehouse.
